verdict.rationale: Docs strongly claim model-agnostic design where 'every model is a string swap away' and list built-in support for OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini plus OpenAI-compatible providers, but hands-on community reports describe breakage when actually switching providers—streaming failures on non-OpenAI models and broken structured output on Azure OpenAI that required abandoning the abstraction, showing the swap isn't always drop-in. missing for 10: independent benchmark confirming seamless swaps across all providers, resolution evidence for the reported provider-specific bugs.
